Traveling with your Apple devices usually means lugging around a tangle of cables and plug adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank aims to solve that problem by combining everything you need into one compact battery. It features built-in folding wall prongs, a detachable USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger for your Apple Watch. It's hands down my favorite travel accessory, handling everything from on-the-go charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wirelessly chargeable Apple devices.

Designed for travel

The back of the RORRY Flow power bank has built-in folding wall prongs. When you need to recharge the battery, there's no need to pack a separate plug adapter — just plug it straight into a wall outlet at your hotel or vacation rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (a feature I absolutely love!), meaning you don't need to pack extra cables to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more.

While I usually focus on MagSafe for iPhone, this power bank specifically includes a 5W magnetic charging puck designed for Apple Watch. When your watch is running low, just set it down and it starts charging — incredibly convenient. The magnet holds it securely in place, so you don't need to bring the original charger.

With a 10,000mAh capacity, this battery has enough juice to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch going for a full day of activities. What really wins me over is the USB-C port's support for 40W output — more than enough to give your MacBook Air a quick top-up (with the lid closed).

RORRY Flow power bank: the verdict

If you're looking to free up some space in your travel bag, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall plug, Apple Watch charger, and USB-C cable into one sleek, pocketable design.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow power bank directly from the RORRY website or Amazon.
